3 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Make evidence activation self-contained after explicit outcomes + Prove the full CLI consumption loop are performed simultaneously?)

missing_original_intent_snapshot: Intent MVP requires original_intent_snapshot_set with sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_intent_collision: Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

scope_ambiguity: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

understanding still has 2 undigested unknowns: Whether the existing auto-apply report can write the deterministic recommend_activate decision itself without weakening digest checks.; Whether the existing smoke can be extended through real dist CLI for outcome_record, auto_promotion_apply, and runtime verification without requiring live project data mutation.
High-risk stories must have plan.md (execution plan). Write it following the plan.md template in CLAUDE.md, one section per CHK-xxx

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. `scope_check_save` already exists; a lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must persist the result through `scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
